sql: SELECT f.seq_veiculo, f.dsc_veiculo, SUM(CAST(g.vlr_gasto AS DECIMAL)) AS total_gasto_combustivel FROM frota_gastoFrota g JOIN frota_frota f ON g.seq_veiculo = f.seq_veiculo WHERE g.ano_referencia = 2024 AND COALESCE(f.dsc_marca, '') NOT ILIKE '%DIVERSOS%' AND COALESCE(f.dsc_num_placa, '') NOT IN ('-1', 'NÃO INFORMADO') GROUP BY f.seq_veiculo, f.dsc_veiculo ORDER BY total_gasto_combustivel DESC LIMIT 1;
